outcome: length of stay in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study reviewed medical records of all neonatal admissions to the NICU at Hermina Hospital, Sukabumi, between July 1, 2022, and July 1, 2023.
finding: Birth weight and Apgar score were significantly associated with the length of stay in the NICU.
mod_finding: Delivery method did not show a significant association with the length of stay in the NICU.
